fields.summary_ko.0: Marvell Technology (MRVL) will report Q3 fiscal year 2027 results on December 1, with stock trading around $138, down approximately 56% from June high of $316.43.
fields.summary_ko.1: Over the last 12 earnings reports, average stock price movement of 12% has occurred post-earnings, with management's next-quarter revenue growth guidance serving as a key driver of stock reaction.
fields.summary_ko.2: MRVL has declined approximately 45% since announcing the Lumentum acquisition on October 28, with this earnings marking the first full quarter report post-acquisition.
